question: What Is a Conditioning Orifice Plate vs a Standard Orifice Plate?
body_html:
A conditioning orifice plate uses multiple symmetric holes to condition disturbed flow, while a standard orifice plate has one sharp edged concentric bore and needs long straight pipe runs.

FeatureStandard PlateConditioning Plate
BoreSingle central holeMultiple small holes
Upstream straight run10D to 50DAbout 2D
Downstream straight runAbout 5DAbout 2D
Beta ratio0.1 to 0.75Around 0.4 or 0.65
Best forSpace available, strict ISO 5167 setupsSkids and retrofits
